_readme: Round 6: Zola Rougon-Macquart volumes, du Maurier, Hardy, Meredith, Pater, Ward, Aldrich, Braddon. Trilby, The Egoist, St. Elmo, and A Harlot High and Low were dropped from the original 20 - already present. His Excellency Eugene Rougon and The Kill (La Curee) skipped - no English translation on Gutenberg.

books.title: The Fortune of the Rougons
books.author: Émile Zola
books.synopsis: During the December 1851 coup d'état, republican insurgents march through the Provençal town of Plassans singing the Marseillaise; the laborer Silvère and the young Miette, marked by her father's crime, share a last embrace before she seizes the insurgent banner and marches to her death. The opening volume of Zola's Rougon-Macquart cycle.

books.title: His Masterpiece
books.author: Émile Zola
books.synopsis: A struggling painter in 1860s Paris shelters a stranded young woman during a storm, and their bond deepens even as his fanatical, doomed pursuit of a single perfect canvas consumes his art, his friendships, and eventually his sanity.

books.title: Abbe Mouret's Transgression
books.author: Émile Zola
books.synopsis: A young priest devoted to celibacy loses his memory after an illness and, nursed back to health in a wild, overgrown estate, falls into a passionate love affair with a girl named Albine — until his identity and vows return, and he must choose between her and the Church.

books.title: A Love Episode
books.author: Émile Zola
books.synopsis: A pious young widow in Paris, absorbed in caring for her sickly daughter, is drawn into a consuming affair with the doctor who treats the child, and her awakened passion threatens to unravel the quiet order of her life.

books.title: Doctor Pascal
books.author: Émile Zola
books.synopsis: An aging scientist researching heredity keeps a secret archive documenting his own family's tainted bloodline, until his mother, desperate to destroy the damning records, turns his household against him. The closing volume of the Rougon-Macquart cycle.

books.title: Peter Ibbetson
books.author: George du Maurier
books.synopsis: Orphaned as a boy and exiled from his idyllic French childhood to a joyless life in London, a man discovers decades later that he can meet his first love in shared, lucid dreams that let them relive and even reshape the past together.

books.title: The Trumpet-Major
books.author: Thomas Hardy
books.synopsis: As invasion fever grips the English coast during the Napoleonic Wars, a miller's steady soldier son and his reckless sailor brother both fall for the same neighboring girl, whose choice between them plays out against the threat of Bonaparte's fleet.

books.title: A Laodicean
books.author: Thomas Hardy
books.synopsis: A young architect sketching Gothic ruins is drawn to a wealthy, modern-minded heiress who is restoring her family's ancient castle with telegraphs and industry, and finds himself entangled in her religious doubts, a rival's schemes, and his own ambitions.

books.title: The Well-Beloved
books.author: Thomas Hardy
books.synopsis: A sculptor spends his life chasing an idealized woman he calls his Well-Beloved, who seems to leap from one real woman to another just as he thinks he has finally caught her — across three generations of the same island family.

books.title: Diana of the Crossways
books.author: George Meredith
books.synopsis: A brilliant, independent Irish beauty becomes the target of Victorian society's gossip and persecution after she leaves her husband, and fights to keep her wit, freedom, and reputation intact through a string of suitors and scandals.

books.title: One of Our Conquerors
books.author: George Meredith
books.synopsis: A charming, successful London businessman lives happily with the woman he loves and their daughter under an arrangement society will not sanction, and races to legitimize it with a grand new estate before his vengeful estranged wife can expose them.

books.title: Imaginary Portraits
books.author: Walter Pater
books.synopsis: Four linked portraits of restless, gifted outsiders across history — a melancholy painter who reshapes Parisian taste, a mysterious youth who brings a golden age to a medieval town before it turns on him, and a Dutch philosopher who rejects the comfort and beauty he was born to.

books.title: Robert Elsmere
books.author: Mrs. Humphry Ward
books.synopsis: A young Oxford-educated clergyman takes up a remote country parish and falls for a devout, austere woman there, even as his growing intellectual doubts about the literal truth of scripture pull him toward a crisis of faith that threatens to end his calling.

books.title: The Story of a Bad Boy
books.author: Thomas Bailey Aldrich
books.synopsis: A spirited boy sent from New Orleans to live with his grandfather in a small New England seaport gets into one scrape after another with his new friends — torching an old stagecoach among them — in a boyhood memoir that helped invent the American "bad boy" genre later perfected by Tom Sawyer.

books.title: Aurora Floyd
books.author: Mary Elizabeth Braddon
books.synopsis: A wealthy banker's beautiful, high-spirited daughter returns from her Paris schooling carrying a dark secret from her past, and a stern naval captain who first scorns her rakish reputation finds himself falling for her anyway — right as that secret threatens to surface.
